run_responses_client: run the openai responses client example that queries a vllm reasoning model via the responses api
create_openai_client: create an openai client pointing to a local vllm server at localhost port 8000
create_response_with_reasoning: create a response using the openai responses api and extract reasoning messages from the output
run_multiturn_reasoning: run a two-turn reasoning conversation by appending reasoning messages and sending them back to the model
review_main: review the main function that demonstrates using the openai responses api with a vllm reasoning model
